decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w8' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9302. Series context: trend strength 0.7635 and seasonal strength 0.3287; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.119); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.375.
